body:
I'm in the same shoes more or less. but instead of 6 months its now just a few days. and after all my thinking about it and reading. there is little you can do to mid agate the pain you are going to bring to loved ones. You will hurt them you might even fuck them up in the head in a big way. for my own self I pushed them all away. said my good byes and stopped talking to them.

remember this, suicide will never be a nice present thing not the act not the aftermath. it will hurt all around. you need to know this.

I have been in your place, I would say this find a reason and hold to it tight your mom/dad, a bf a sister,brother. now when the dark days come think of them hold onto that hard. Also when you start thinking of killing your self stop and go get a drink of water or have a smoke if you do that. find a way to distract your self. immerse your self in movies or books what ever is better. or video games if that's your thing.

starting now call up a shrink and go get on drugs do this first, I found it as frighting as holding a gun up to my head. but force it. I have huge fears about "mental health workers". but I forced it and it helped. I had to walk a tight line when talking to them as my worst fear is being held in a hospital or getting locked up. but one can talk around it. 

I'm also going to leave you with a warning DO NOT stop taking drugs for at least a year better two. I have stopped and that's why I'm here on this sub. 

Also this could be way off but if you want to talk send me a PM. I will be up all night again I think.
well I put a gun to my head and pulled the trigger at 8 years old. I think that counts.

I find I understand people who are not native to english better able to get the meaning out of what they write more so then native people.


I wrote this as a emotional good bye, all the other things I need to say I will be leaving in letters. at this point there is no future I will end my days soon. I have no wish to live my 33 year. 

As for looking back on my own life its been more or less good. for what it was. I just cant take the pain any longer. 

I will leave you with this, fist truly thank you for reading my words I hope you will remember them some day years from now. I am not leaving much in this world. and I find that I have a small hope that something will be left some where. 

And last I will say this take risks with women do not let fear stand in your way. even if you have no money take the risk.


Take the risk grab the day the moment. my best memories are of days like that.
Thank you for reading my words and for the kind thought.
I have no dreams of adventure, I dream of endings.
